text: This book's counting of gauge conditions on the symmetric amplitude A_μν leaves ___ independent physical polarization states for a gravitational wave.
explanation: Starting from the 10 components of the symmetric A_μν, the Lorenz gauge and the residual transverse-traceless gauge freedom remove the unphysical components, leaving exactly two physical, gauge-invariant polarizations — the plus and cross modes. The other components are pure gauge (coordinate) effects that can be transformed away.
